name: un_get_sdgs
description:
List the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals, from the UN Statistics Division SDG API (no API key).
Returns: sdgs (code, title, color hex, uri and, when asked, description) and count; on failure an error and note instead.
Inputs (none required): include_details (boolean; default false; adds each goal's description).
Next steps: un_get_sdg_targets for a goal's targets, un_get_sdg_indicators for its indicators.
Example: {"include_details": true}

include_details.description: Include detailed description for each SDG

sdgs.description: List of all Sustainable Development Goals

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Returns all 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals. Data is relatively static and can be cached for long periods.

examples.description: Get all SDGs with basic info
